His parents giving all his attention to his older brother; Curlos gave his lunch to a child in need? Oh well your older brother Ivan has some how brought a  bakery and fed the entire village. Curlos hit the target with perfect precision right in the bullseye? Oh well Ivan pierced right through the arrow with a perfect form.*
